title: Skill File Checker
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agents for Robotics
description: Check eight skill-file headers against the five rules of the OpenClaw skill format. For each header, say that it is valid or name the one rule that it breaks. Used in Chapter 15.

educational.topic: OpenClaw skill files and the rules of their front matter
learningObjectives: Validate eight skill-file headers against the rules of the OpenClaw skill format, naming the one rule that each breaks or saying that it is valid, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Check each item against stated criteria and name the criterion that fails, with the correct outcome and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Which rule, if any, does this header break?
Why must a description with a colon and a space be in quotes?
commonMisconceptions: The skill's rules are enforced by the agent's good behavior
Capital letters and underscores are fine in a name
A colon in a description is harmless
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed outcomes; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Start / Check / Next header / See score / Try again
